sin.name: whole-shell-line-read
sin.description: Code reads the whole shell line to decide something, so a command is judged by where it stands in a chain rather than by what each part does.
sin.rule: Read the parts of the line, or ask an aggregate on ShellLine: has_test_run_part, has_part_writing_files, is_read_only, has_part_running, has_part_matching, parts_running_journal_command, part_texts. Add a new aggregate to ShellLine if none fits. The source line is private to ShellLine: display_text shows it and runner_text hands it to the runner.
